scope: Actual production create/configure/launch/update/render CPU attribute fills; renderer.render is an inert capture, never a GPU draw.

Isolated real root0 centered at each distance, no depth/air/overlap/bloom/vignette/DoF. Widths are continuous horizontal code-threshold spans, not screenshot pixels or real-world visibility measurements.

CPU binary64 translation of existing GLSL pixel Gaussian, shutter8 taps and legacy fitted-ACES/HDR extension; Float32 upload and stored FP16 quantization are included, GPU arithmetic and compositing are not.
Storage and camera exposure cancel analytically before finite FP16 quantization; EV21 is this app relative gain, not EV100.
HDR1270 is a system-report setting, not physical panel luminance calibration or HDR approval.
